original: Poisson 模型对非负计数 \(y\ge 0\) 使用 \(p(y|\lambda )=\lambda ^ye^{-\lambda }/y\)!。其自然参数为 \(\theta =\log\lambda\)，令线性预测量 \(\eta =\theta\)，便得到反连接函数 \(\lambda =e^\eta\)。指数函数将任意实数预测量映到正均值，对数似然则写成 Σ[yη-e^η-log(y!)]。求导后，梯度由协变量乘以观测计数与预测计数之差构成。

original: 单个结果越罕见，带来的惊奇度应越大；两个独立事件同时发生时，惊奇度应相加。独立事件的联合概率为 pq，因此满足 \(S(pq)=S(p)+S(q)\) 的连续单调形式是 \(S(p)=-\log_{bp}\)。以 2 为底时单位为比特，以 e 为底时单位为奈特；概率为 1 的事件不带来惊奇。

original: For a nonnegative integer count \(y\ge 0\), the Poisson model is \(p(y|\lambda )=\lambda ^ye^{-\lambda }/y\)!. Its canonical parameter is \(\theta =\log\lambda\), predictor \(\eta =\theta\), and inverse link \(\lambda =e^\eta\). The exponential maps every real predictor to a positive mean and gives log likelihood Σ[yη-e^η-log(y!)], whose gradient is the covariate times observed minus predicted count.

original: Surprise for one outcome should increase as its probability decreases, and surprises for independent events should add. Because their joint probability is pq, the continuous monotone solution of \(S(pq)=S(p)+S(q)\) is \(S(p)=-\log_{bp}\). Base 2 gives bits and base e gives nats; an event of probability 1 has zero surprise.

Because their joint probability is pq, the continuous monotone solution of \(S(pq)=S(p)+S(q)\) is \(S(p)=-\log_b p\). original: 平方指数核 \(K(t,t')=\sigma s^{2}\) \(\exp[-(t-t')^{2}/(2\tau ^{2})]+\sigma n^{2}\delta tt'\) 描述同一因子在两个时刻的协方差。\(\sigma s^{2}\) 控制平滑信号的方差，\(\tau\) 控制相关衰减的时间尺度，\(\sigma n^{2}\) 只在同一时间窗加入独立波动。由于潜在状态 \(\alpha\) 与载荷 C 存在整体尺度歧义，可以采用 \(\sigma n^{2}+\sigma s^{2}=1\) 固定尺度；它是归一化约定，而非生物定律。平方指数核也不是唯一选择，快速切换或周期变化可考虑 Matérn 核或周期核。

original: Morris–Lecar compresses conductance dynamics into two state variables, V and N. Its voltage equation is C dV/dt=-gL(V-EL)-gCa M∞(V)(V-ECa)-gK \(N(V-E_{K})+I_{e}\). Each \(g(V-E)\) is conductance times driving force; the preceding minus signs follow the outward-current convention. \(M_{\infty }(V)\) assumes fast Ca activation and therefore takes its voltage-dependent steady-state value immediately, whereas N follows \(N_{\infty }(V)\) on a slower time scale.

original: With samples as columns, write the loss \(L(W)=1/2||Y-WX||_F^{2}\). The Frobenius norm sums squared residuals across all outputs and samples. original: Differentiating with respect to w gives gradient \((wX-y)X^\mathrm{T}\). Setting it to zero gives the normal equation wXX^\(T=yX^\mathrm{T}\). original: The squared-exponential kernel \(K(t,t')=\sigma s^{2}\) \(\exp[-(t-t')^{2}/(2\tau ^{2})]+\sigma n^{2}\delta tt'\) gives covariance between two times for one factor. \(\sigma s^{2}\) controls smooth signal variance, \(\tau\) controls the correlation-decay time, and \(\sigma n^{2}\) adds independent variability only in the same time bin. Because \(\alpha\) and loading C have a global scale ambiguity, impose \(\sigma n^{2}+\sigma s^{2}=1\) as a normalization convention. That constraint fixes scale; it is not a new biological law. Nor is this the only GP kernel: for rapid switching or oscillation, Matérn or periodic kernels may better match the hypothesis.

original: Return from time t is \(G_{t}=\sum _{k=0}\infty \gamma ^kR_{t+k+1}\). The first term is undiscounted, the following reward is multiplied by \(\gamma\), and so on. \(\gamma\) is not a learning rate; it changes temporal preference and mathematical convergence of the objective. A finite episode can use \(\gamma =1\), whereas continuing positive reward generally requires \(\gamma <1\).

original: Retrieval cue \(S(0)\) has overlap \(m=(1/N)\sum i\xi iS_{i}\) with the target pattern. \(m=1\) is an exact match, \(m=0\) is uncorrelated on average, and \(m=-1\) is the global antipattern. original: A target bit is stable when \(\xi _{i}^{1}h_{i}>0\): unit-aligned signal 1 plus noise remains positive. original: 估计滤波核后，为每个时间格计算投影 \(L_{t}=\hat{K}^\mathrm{T}s_{t}\)，按投影值分组，估计经验概率 \(P(\mathrm{spike}|L)\)。小时间格下的 Poisson 近似给出 \(P(k=1|L)\approx \Delta tF(L)\)，因此 Fhat(L)=P(脉冲|L)/Δt。最后，将滤波核、非线性与 Poisson 输出组合，在未参与拟合的刺激上比较预测和实际放电，才能检验完整模型。
